generation.scope: Every nonvertex simple on any finite regular window whose corners satisfy four-matrix identities has constant dimension vector. Every homogeneous prime quotient, and the quotient by the radical, are left and right Noetherian. A semiprime corner therefore implies a center-finite composable domain on every component. The remaining mixed profile (2,2,2,3) is excluded by incompatible lower and upper bounds on second Ext between universal head and socle extensions.

open_mathematics: Apply the absence of mixed vertex trace fibers in families to decide domainness at arbitrary finite regular specializations of the fifteen-dimensional component, and address uncovered high-rank windows.
